blockingIssues.description: `backend/janus-api/internal/core/migrate_test.go` still contains literal `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` strings outside migration files, so the feature does not satisfy VAL-BH-002's required grep condition.
The `FROM projects WHERE id=$1` query pattern still appears in multiple repository methods/files, so SQL deduplication required by VAL-BH-008 is incomplete.
`ResolveDomainRuntimeEndpoint` performs `LOWER(domain)` lookup without a matching expression index, leaving a hot single-entity lookup effectively unindexed and failing VAL-BH-009.
Several telemetry/admin/event handlers in `internal/api/handler/telemetry_admin_events.go` do not reject unsupported HTTP methods with 405, so VAL-BH-006 remains unmet.
`TemplatesRoute`, `BackendResourcesRoute`, and `LogsRoute` accept unsupported methods with 200, and `GitProvidersRoute` returns 501 instead of 405 for wrong methods.
The added tests do not cover the requested core repository operations for auth, projects, builds, deployments, and operations, so the promised comprehensive core-domain coverage is still missing.
`internal/api/readyz_test.go` does not verify the healthy 200 path or the `actors.actor_system` / `actors.command_gateway` checks required by VAL-BH-012.

appliedUpdates.description: Added reusable `build-backend` and `vet-backend` commands so backend scrutiny/user-testing workers can reuse the standard compile and vet validators without rediscovering them.
Added `.factory/library/backend-hardening.md` documenting the current repository-interface state, embedded migration gotchas, common backend validation commands, and the `/readyz` response shape.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax the mandatory red-first TDD instruction for refactors and enhancement work. Clarify that workers may start from a green baseline, then add or expand verification when the feature is structural rather than new behavior.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple backend-hardening reviews (bh-migration-tooling, bh-repository-implementation, bh-error-handling, bh-core-tests) found the current skill wording mismatched the actual successful workflow and led to inaccurate `followedProcedure=true` handoffs.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit backend route convention that every read-only handler must reject unsupported HTTP methods (for example via `requireMethod`), and require wrong-method coverage for any newly added route tests.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The bh-error-handling review found multiple GET-only telemetry/admin/misc routes still accepting unsupported methods or returning 501 instead of 405, despite shared guidance already mentioning structured errors and correct status codes.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add migration up/down commands directly to `.factory/services.yaml`.
Architecture-library staleness reports from bh-repository-interfaces and bh-repository-implementation.
